about: Patterns for stripping non-JD boilerplate from job descriptions. Read by apps/web/lib/jd-clean.ts and apps/api/app/discovery/jobs/jd_clean.py. Regexes are case-insensitive and use syntax common to JavaScript and Python (no lookbehind, no named groups).
